## Introduction

This was a Shiny App project completed in another class. I created a shiny app that would webscrape Baseball player data from the website [Baseball-Reference](https://www.baseball-reference.com/) based on the inputs of the user. Then using the R package `gganimate` it created a moving plot showing the trend in the league wide data, split by division, over the span of 10 years.
